name: 首次响应 SLA - 坐席与主管分档提醒

parameters.query:
SELECT due.ticket_id, due.priority, due.intent, due.assigned_agent, due.created_at, due.elapsed_seconds, due.sla_level
FROM (
 SELECT t.ticket_id,t.priority,t.intent,t.assigned_agent,t.created_at,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW()) elapsed_seconds,
  CASE WHEN t.priority='urgent' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=300 THEN 'severe_timeout'
       WHEN t.priority='urgent' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=240 THEN 'pre_timeout'
       WHEN t.priority='normal' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=3600 THEN 'severe_timeout'
       WHEN t.priority='normal' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=1800 THEN 'timeout'
       WHEN t.priority='normal' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=1440 THEN 'pre_timeout' ELSE NULL END sla_level,
  CASE WHEN t.priority='urgent' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=300 THEN 3
       WHEN t.priority='urgent' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=240 THEN 1
       WHEN t.priority='normal' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=3600 THEN 3
       WHEN t.priority='normal' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=1800 THEN 2
       WHEN t.priority='normal' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,t.created_at,NOW())>=1440 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END current_rank,
  COALESCE(FIELD(t.sla_agent_notified_level,'pre_timeout','timeout','severe_timeout'),0) agent_notified_rank,
  COALESCE(FIELD(t.sla_supervisor_notified_level,'pre_timeout','timeout','severe_timeout'),0) supervisor_notified_rank
 FROM tickets t WHERE t.status='open' AND t.sla_tracking_enabled=1
  AND (t.sla_claimed_at IS NULL OR t.sla_claimed_at<NOW()-INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
) due WHERE due.sla_level IS NOT NULL AND due.current_rank>LEAST(due.agent_notified_rank,due.supervisor_notified_rank)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN due.priority='urgent' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,due.created_at,due.ticket_id;
